data.title: 和栗薰子 · 白花礼堂里的轻声道谢
data.description: 白花装点的小礼堂里，薰子穿有蓬袖和层叠长裙的白色婚纱，花朵头纱覆在黑紫色长发上。她双手捧住带草莓装饰的花束，低头看见其中的小白花后温柔微笑，蓝眼清澈，姿态安静而郑重。
data.action: 双手捧着花束，低头看小白花时露出温柔笑容。
data.promptProse: Inside the small white-flower chapel, Kaoruko Waguri holds a bouquet with fresh strawberry decorations and notices a tiny white bloom among them, smiling gently down. Her layered white bridal gown and flower veil frame long blackish-purple hair and clear blue eyes. The medium portrait includes the small altar and gathered skirt. Soft window light reflected from the chapel walls reveals lace and petal layers, with subtle bouquet shadows across her sleeves.
